subject: hydrangea
name: 绣球花
label: 圆团绣球花
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. One small hydrangea flower head made of five large four-petal blossoms grouped together, a short stem and two broad leaves.
Composition check: complete subject centered inside the central 76% of the square with generous 12% clear margins. Pure black contour lines, open white interiors, no shading. Respect the low number of parts specified, no dense repeated small decorations.
